newsitem.title: USA: Immunex may accelerate FLT-3 trials.
newsitem.headline: Immunex may accelerate FLT-3 trials.

text.p: Immunex Corp said Thursday it had completed the first human trials of FLT-3 ligand, and Phase II studies expected to begin in the second quarter may be accelerated.
The drug stimulates development and production of stem cells, which give rise to the body's immune system cells. It was shown in Phase 1 trials to be safe and well tolerated, the company said.
Immunex said it is testing FLT-3 ligand to mobilize stem cells into the blood. Peripheral blood stem cells are being used increasingly to replace cells damaged by aggressive chemotherapy.
Immunex said a second Phase I multiple-dose study will test the drug at escalating dose levels.
Phase II studies will test the efficacy of FLT-3 ligand in combination with approved growth factors, it said.
